plain_english: Before, emission dissolved, fire-made — where would it shine, facing beyond-joy? It goes, moon-touch-lovely, sharing fire-moon-expanse-both-power. O Bhairava Lord — may this emission-named of Yours sport always in my mind.
sanskrit_cite: purā sṛṣṭir līnā hutavahamayī | taveyaṃ sṛṣṭyākhyā mama manasi nityaṃ vilasatām
